meta.name: architecture
meta.description: Architectural design, system patterns, and dependency management. Use when designing new modules, refactoring existing systems, or making architectural decisions. Covers layering, coupling, cohesion, and design patterns.

copy.tagline: 设计清晰可维护的软件架构
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正为系统架构和代码结构做关键决策。
copy.tagline_en: Design clear and maintainable software architecture
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are a developer making architectural decisions for software systems.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会要求每个架构决策都写明理由并存档，拒绝隐式选择；它按关注点分离、依赖向内、API 先行、数据流清晰等原则审查设计，并用清单逐项检查，同时引用模式库、标记反模式。
howto.when: 当你要设计新模块、重构现有系统，或做 API 契约等架构决策时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个新模块的架构，先明确单一职责。
say.note: 它会要求明确职责并运行评估清单。

say.text: 检查现有系统的依赖关系，有没有循环依赖？
say.note: 它会用依赖规则审查并标记反模式。

say.text: 我们该如何为这个 API 设计契约和版本？
say.note: 它会强调 API 先行并给出契约方案。

howto.what_en: Claude makes every architectural decision explicit, documented, and justified; it checks separation of concerns, dependency rules, API-first, and data flow clarity, runs a checklist, and flags anti-patterns from the patterns library.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you are designing a new module, refactoring an existing system, or making architectural decisions such as API contracts.

say_en.text: Design a new module with a single clear responsibility.
say_en.note: It asks for explicit responsibilities and runs the checklist.

say_en.text: Check the system dependencies for circular ones.
say_en.note: It reviews with the dependency rule and flags anti-patterns.

say_en.text: How should we design the API contract and versioning?
say_en.note: It emphasizes API-first and proposes a contract plan.
